name: My Sweet Fairy!
source:
Play as Valerie (Name and look changeable!), a businesswoman on vacation in a quaint cottage, when she stumbles upon a fairy in the rain. What follows is a whirlwind experience in the fae-realm, with all its whimsical delights. But not every place is perfect, and sometimes it takes human common sense to sort it all out. She finds what she expected least—a love connection, but is being from two completely different worlds too much for a relationship to survive?  

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/my-sweet-fairy]itch.io[/url]]
